title: Accounting and Tax Services for Clothing Stores

rows.before: We incorporated under the Ontario Business Corporations Act, moved the inventory, fixtures and goodwill across on a section 85 rollover, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 12.2%, deferred gift-card revenue until redemption, and capitalized the fixtures as Class 8 and the fit-out as Class 13.
rows.after: We incorporated under the Ontario Business Corporations Act, moved the inventory, fixtures and goodwill across on a section 85 rollover, applied the $500,000 Small Business Deduction so active income is taxed near 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026), deferred gift-card revenue until redemption, and capitalized the fixtures as Class 8 and the fit-out as Class 13.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).
